form.label: 1. Röntgengerät — DHCP / IP Drift
form.description: Detect when a critical, supposedly-static device silently gets reassigned by DHCP — before it takes an outage to notice.

html.p: "…Röntgengerät ist letzte Woche ausgestiegen, weil die IP-Adresse aus unerklärlichen Gründen auf DHCP umgestellt wurde…" — a reserved device's IP silently flipped to DHCP; the outage took hours to trace back to it.

panel.title: Time to detect — before vs. with Splunk
Device reachability around the lease change — the outage that followed

search.query: | makeresults count=24 | streamstats count as i | eval Hour=strftime(relative_time(now(), "-".(24-i)."h"), "%H:00") | eval "Reachable (XRAY-Radiology-03)"=if(i>=15 AND i<=19, 0, 1) | table Hour "Reachable (XRAY-Radiology-03)"

| makeresults count=3 | streamstats count as i | eval Category=case(i=1,"Normal static renewal",i=2,"Normal DHCP renewal",i=3,"Unexpected re-assignment") | eval Count=case(i=1,84,i=2,206,i=3,1) | table Category Count

panel.title: Recent lease events for reserved/critical assets

search.query: | makeresults count=6 | streamstats count as i | eval Time=strftime(relative_time(now(), "-".(7-i)."d"), "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M") | eval Asset=case(i=1,"MRI-Suite2-CTL",i=2,"US-Cardio-04",i=3,"XRAY-Radiology-03",i=4,"XRAY-Radiology-03",i=5,"Infusion-Pump-Gateway",i=6,"CT-Scanner-01") | eval "New IP"=case(i=1,"10.20.5.21",i=2,"10.20.5.33",i=3,"10.20.5.44",i=4,"10.20.5.187",i=5,"10.20.5.61",i=6,"10.20.5.72") | eval Risk=case(i=4,"HIGH — reserved asset re-leased by DHCP",1=1,"normal renewal") | table Time Asset "New IP" Risk | sort Time

format.colorPalette: {"HIGH — reserved asset re-leased by DHCP":#d93f3c,"normal renewal":#53a051}
